# Default

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Control Flow](Language-Features-Control-Flow)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Default
```

## Description

The last part of a [Select](Select): its statements run when none of the [Case](Case) values matched.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Select 42
	Case 1 : Print "one"
	Default : Print "no case matched"
End Select
```

```text
no case matched
```

## Related Commands

[Case](Case), [Else](Else), [ElseIf](ElseIf)
